source.note: This case isolates the OutboundTransformer URL-joining behavior (baseURL normalization, trailing-slash and /v1/openai suffix). It captures TWO sub-variants under outbound_http[*]; the unified_request is the same minimal request the Go test feeds in. selected_channel, upstream_http and client_http are null because the Go outbound-only unit test does not exercise those stages.
